_comment: Real drones ON THE GROUND, props-off validation: discovery + connect + telemetry + video + ArUco on real streamed frames. Flight commands are REFUSED by BenchAdapter. plane_ids/LEDs/bands are placeholders — set from the real fleet at gate A.
_detector_note: ArUco is the primary detector and always runs in the perception loop (convoy robots carry markers to detect + READ — no training needed). YOLO is the optional extra: enable with backend 'ultralytics' + weights ONLY if the briefing scores marker-less robot spotting.
